verdict.rationale: Supabase exposes a documented, auto-generated REST/GraphQL API, an OpenAPI spec, a CLI usable headlessly by scripts/agents, and an official MCP server for AI assistants to query projects, all confirmed by live probes (openapi.json 200, CLI headless run, MCP handshake). Community evidence shows real-world AI agent usage via MCP, though with security caveats around service_role bypassing RLS.
